# ex: implicit * cancels with inner & in matched expression (paren-wrapped)
ex {
	var t T
	t.F -> println(t.F, t)
}
-- x.go --
package p

type T struct{ F int }

func f(v T) {
	println((&v).F)
}
-- stderr --
x.go:6:10: println((&v).F, v) (no value) used as value
errors found after executing: ex { \ ...
-- stdout --
diff old/x.go new/x.go
--- old/x.go
+++ new/x.go
@@ -3,5 +3,5 @@

-	println((&v).F)
+	println(println((&v).F, v))
 }
